title: All five v89 value_pooled routes measured — plus the r-family verdict the §3 tooling skipped
registration: gen13_endofrun_runbook.md §2 (bar: KEEP at dV >= 0.5 x threat = 0.39) and §3 (family ALIVE at >= 0.5 x median live family)

instrument.design: ONE generic arm keyed off the `_value_pooled_routes` registry seam, not five bespoke arms — the seam already yields (name, contribution), so the arm set CANNOT drift from the route set. That drift is exactly what happened: value_clock / value_intent / intent_threshold_value shipped in v84/v87, trained live through all of gen-13, and had no arm when the §2 verdict was first computed.
instrument.cross_check: the generic arm reproduces the two BESPOKE arms EXACTLY (entity_pool 6.2754 == 6.2754; intent_reduce 0.3826 == 0.3826) — two independent mechanisms, one number

intent_value_reduce.note: 98% of bar — the ratified coin-flip; owner tie-break is a >=2x-sample re-run in the gen-14 battery

value_clock.note: 86% of bar — the SECOND near-bar route; same tie-break logic applies

intent_threshold_value.note: the v84 p_KO-to-critic route — ledger H1's intended payoff

value_routes.reading: KL and flips are 0.0 on every one, which is CORRECT for a vf-only route and is itself a check that the arms hit the value path and nothing else. §2's 'all five null => gen-14 deletes the lot' branch does NOT fire: entity_pool keeps decisively and carries the critic.

edge_families.rule: ALIVE at dV >= 0.5 x median live family

r.note: ALIVE but only just — it sits essentially AT the median (0.0571 vs 0.0551), not above it. Zero-init, so any nonzero is learned use; but this is a weak pass, not a strong one.

edge_families.incidental: the consequence families remain at/below the noise floor (c4 0.0006; c1/c2/c3/c5 0.017-0.020), independently corroborating the gen-14 draft's trim list.

caveats: dV measures DEPENDENCE of the trained gen-13 forward. A route can read low because a substitute already carries the content — which is the entity_pool succession story, and why threat fell 100% -> 14% of all_off between generations.

Two routes sit within 15% of the bar (intent_value_reduce 0.383, value_clock 0.337). At n=6000 that margin is not resolvable; the ratified tie-break (>=2x sample in the gen-14 battery) applies to BOTH, not just intent_value_reduce.
